label: Round Hem
description: The Round hem — also called the shirttail hem — curves upward at the sides from a longer front and back tail, creating the classic dress shirt profile that stays tucked securely into trousers. The rising curve at each side seam reduces bulk at the hip when tucked while ensuring adequate length at front and back to remain anchored throughout the day. This is the standard hem shape for formal and business dress shirts worldwide.
